post_title: US Visa Scheduling Middle Name in the first name?
concerns_or_questions_summary: User entered their middle name as part of the given name during US visa scheduling registration so their profile now shows 'JUAN SANTOS' as first name; they ask whether to request an amendment, noting that removing the middle name would create a mismatch with their DS-160.
embedding_text: US Visa Scheduling Middle Name in the first name?. User entered their middle name as part of the given name during US visa scheduling registration so their profile now shows 'JUAN SANTOS' as first name; they ask whether to request an amendment, noting that removing the middle name would create a mismatch with their DS-160.
